Remove the two screws and the moulding.

REPLACEMENT OF FASTENER AND CLIP

If any fastener or clip is damaged, replace it.

1. REMOVE DAMAGED CLIP

2. CUT OLD ADHESIVE OFF AROUND CLIP INSTALLATION AREA
(a) Grind a notch into the clip so it latches onto the glass edge.

(b) Temporarily install the clip and confirm that the clip tip is not sunk below the surface.
(c) If the tip of the clip is sunk below the surface, replace it.

3. REMOVE ANY DAMAGED FASTENER

4. CUT OLD ADHESIVE OFF AROUND FASTENER INSTALLATION AREA

5. INSTALL FASTENER

INSTALLATION OF OUTSIDE MOULDING
(See page BO-12)

1. INSTALL LOWER MOULDING

2. INSTALL NEW CLIP INTO MOULDING
Install the moulding to the body so that the clips and fasteners are not in a position where they will contact each other.
